daily_targets.why: They struggle with lead quality and speed-to-lead conversion - our exact pain point to solve
daily_targets.comment_approach: Acknowledge their conversion challenge, offer specific insight about response time
daily_targets.example_comment: The 30-second hang-up issue is brutal. We saw PI firms cut abandonment rates 40% just by having someone pick up within 20 seconds. What's your current answer rate looking like?
daily_targets.timing: Within 2 hours of post (when engagement is climbing)

daily_targets.why: They influence law firms buying marketing services; partnership/referral potential
daily_targets.comment_approach: Build on their insights, add data-backed perspective from legal sector
daily_targets.example_comment: 21 years in legal marketing and AI is definitely reshaping discovery. The biggest edge we're seeing: firms using AI to qualify leads before human contact. Cuts wasted calls dramatically.
daily_targets.timing: Within 4 hours of post (before algorithm cools)

daily_targets.why: Budget-conscious, DIY mindset, most likely to need affordable marketing solutions
daily_targets.comment_approach: Be the helpful mentor, position as guide not salesperson
daily_targets.example_comment: Great post. For newer lawyers on limited budgets: before spending on ads, nail your phone intake process. We've seen solos convert 3x better by just improving how they answer calls. Worth auditing first.
daily_targets.timing: Within 6 hours of post (catch the intentional seekers)

daily_targets.why: Different practice areas = different lead sources; content signals they're investing in business growth
daily_targets.comment_approach: Show you understand their niche challenges
daily_targets.example_comment: Employment law hiring is competitive right now. If you're scaling, the paralegal role quality matters—they're often first voice clients hear. Have you optimized how your intake team qualifies candidates?

daily_targets.account_type: Legal Tech & Practice Management Tool Companies
daily_targets.why: They serve lawyers; co-marketing and referral partnerships possible
daily_targets.comment_approach: Complement their solution, show integration value
daily_targets.example_comment: Tools like this solve intake workflow, but we're seeing the real bottleneck is pre-intake: getting calls answered fast. Firms using [tool name] + optimized phone systems see 2x better lead conversion.

daily_targets.why: Highly localized, niche practice = need geo-specific marketing; active on X with case-related posts
daily_targets.example_comment: County residency rules matter for divorce, but your lead SOURCE doesn't have to be local. We're helping NJ family law firms pull leads from statewide searches. Worth exploring if geo-targeting is costing you cases.
daily_targets.timing: Within 1 hour of post (X moves faster)

comment_templates.trigger: Post about lead cost / ROI challenges
comment_templates.template: [Account name], your $5K/month spend sounds typical. Before scaling budget, audit this: what % of your callers hang up in first 30 seconds? We see firms cut cost-per-case 35% just by answering faster. Worth measuring before your next ad spend.
comment_templates.goal: Position as problem-solver, create credibility, invite DM conversation

comment_templates.trigger: Post about hiring legal staff / paralegal roles
comment_templates.template: Quality intake staff = quality leads. Seen too many firms hire based on legal knowledge when they should hire on phone/communication skills first. Your first conversation sets case quality. What's your intake training like currently?
comment_templates.goal: Show expertise, open dialogue, identify if they're growth-stage

comment_templates.trigger: Post about legal marketing trends / AI / new strategies
comment_templates.template: [Account/insight mentioned]. Agreed. We're tracking this in [practice area] and seeing [specific outcome]. The advantage goes to firms who [actionable insight]. Have you implemented this angle yet?
comment_templates.goal: Build authority, show real data, position as insider

comment_templates.template: Good question. Location matters for compliance, but DON'T let it limit your lead generation strategy. Smart firms in [state] are pulling clients from broader regions then handling local requirements. Might be leaving money on table otherwise.

comment_templates.trigger: Post about practice growth / scaling challenges
comment_templates.template: Scaling is hard because [insight]. Most firms focus on getting more leads when they should focus on [conversion metric]. We worked with a firm doing exactly what you're doing—turned it around by [specific change]. Happy to share what worked.
comment_templates.goal: Offer specific help, build relationship, set up potential consultation

comment_templates.trigger: Post about specific practice area (PI, employment, family law, real estate, etc.)
comment_templates.template: [Practice area] firms we work with struggle most with [specific problem]. The ones winning are doing [specific tactic]. If you're not doing this already, worth a test.
comment_templates.goal: Show niche expertise, suggest immediate action

rules: NEVER mention your service/product directly in comment—only mention in natural follow-up DMs
Always ask a question at the end—drives engagement, boosts comment visibility
Use specific numbers/data—'35% improvement' beats 'significant results'
Reference their post directly by name/detail—shows you actually read it
Reply to replies within 2 hours—compounds algorithmic lift
Comment on accounts with 500-50K followers (sweet spot for reach without algorithms favoring size)
Never comment on the same account more than 2x per week (avoid seeming spammy)
Match tone to platform: LinkedIn = professional/insightful, X = conversational/quick
Add value FIRST, relationship-building second, selling never in comments
Target posts 1-48 hours old (freshest engagement window)

growth_projection.caveat: Growth compounds when you convert comments → DMs → calls. Real ROI is leads, not follower count.

success_metrics.track_daily: comments per day, replies received, DM inquiries
success_metrics.track_weekly: follower growth, total engagements, which comment types perform
success_metrics.track_monthly: DMs that converted to calls, calls that converted to cases
success_metrics.goal: 10-15 DM conversations per month → 2-4 qualified leads per month
